WITH s AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(f.quantity) units, sum(f.net_amount) sales_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 0 ELSE f.net_amount END) sales_nostaff
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND st.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(r.quantity_returned) ru, sum(r.refund_net) refunds
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND st.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.sku, s.units, coalesce(r.ru,0) ru, s.sales_net, coalesce(r.refunds,0) refunds, s.sales_net-coalesce(r.refunds,0) net_after, s.sales_nostaff - coalesce(r.refunds,0) net_after_nostaff
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING(sku) ORDER BY net_after DESC LIMIT 14

WITH s AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(f.quantity) units_sold, sum(f.net_amount) sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND st.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY p.sku),
r AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(rl.quantity_returned) units_returned, sum(rl.refund_net) refunds_net
  FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = rl.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = rl.store_key
  WHERE rl.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND st.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY p.sku),
cur AS (SELECT sku, product_name, category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds_net, 0) DESC) AS rank,
       s.sku, cur.product_name, cur.category,
       s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds_net, 0) AS net_sales_eur,
       s.units_sold - coalesce(r.units_returned, 0) AS net_units
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (sku) JOIN cur USING (sku)
ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC LIMIT 10
